item.description: As part of its continued expansion in Southeast Asia, Xpeng will officially enter the Philippine market in the third quarter of 2026 through Xpeng Philippines. item.title: Moving people toward electric
item.description: WITH THE increased adoption and openness of the local automotive market to electrified options — particularly after the onset of the US-Iran war — Hyundai Motor Philippines (HMPH) recently grew its hybrid portfolio further with the introduction of Staria Hybrid offerings.

item.title: Looking beyond the gloom
item.description: WE CHEERED as Alex Eala broke into Round 3 of the 2026 Wimbledon Championships by defeating the defending champion Iga Swiatek in straight sets.

item.title: Jeep out
item.description: THE CHRYSLER, Dodge, Jeep, and Ram (CDJR) group of brands under Stellantis has had a long-standing partnership in the Philippines through the CATS distribution group. In 2023, CATS merged with the biggest automotive distribution company in the world, establishing Inchcape Philippines.

item.title: Audi expands hybrid range
item.description: Audi Philippines has added to its hybrid range with a higher-spec version of the Q5 and the local debut of two performance models, the SQ5 Sportback Hybrid and S5 Sedan Hybrid.

item.title: Toyota racers split Clark victories
item.description: Red Diwa and Iñigo Anton each scored two class victories as the Toyota Gazoo Racing Philippine Cup completed Race Weekend 2 at Clark International Speedway in Pampanga.
